title: Khmer PFGen-Bench: Building a Judge-Free Benchmark for Open-Ended Generation in a Low-Resource Language
abstract: arXiv:2611.09222v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Benchmarks for open-ended generation often rely on large language model (LLM) judges, whose reliability in low-resource languages is uncertain. We introduce Khmer PFGen-Bench, to our knowledge the first judge-free benchmark for multi-sentence answers to questions composed directly in Khmer, a low-resource language. Khmer PFGen-Bench adapts the scorer of PFGen-Bench, a benchmark for Japanese that scores responses with keyword rules and n-gram statistics from LLM-generated references. This scoring requires references that are both valid and varied, which LLMs may not produce in Khmer, so we examine how to build such references. We find that post-trained models can give more valid but less varied references than their base variants, and that mixing model families increases variety for the same number of references. translated_title: 高棉语 PFGen-Bench：为低资源语言构建无裁判的开放式生成基准
translated_abstract: 开放式生成的基准测试通常依赖大语言模型（LLM）裁判，但其在低资源语言中的可靠性尚不确定。我们提出了 Khmer PFGen-Bench，据我们所知，这是首个针对直接以高棉语（一种低资源语言）撰写的问题进行多句回答的无裁判基准。Khmer PFGen-Bench 改编了 PFGen-Bench（一个日语基准）的评分器，该评分器使用关键词规则和来自 LLM 生成参考答案的 n-gram 统计数据对回答进行评分。这种评分方式需要既有效又多样化的参考答案，而 LLM 在高棉语中可能无法生成这样的参考答案，因此我们研究了如何构建此类参考答案。我们发现，经过后训练的模型相比其基础模型变体能提供更有效但多样性更低的参考答案，并且在相同参考答案数量的情况下，混合不同模型家族可以增加多样性。使用来自九个模型家族的后训练模型生成的参考答案，该基准所产生的模型排名在不同参考集之间保持稳定。
tldr: 该论文提出了 Khmer PFGen-Bench，这是首个针对高棉语这一低资源语言的无裁判开放式生成基准，并发现混合九个模型家族的后训练模型生成的参考答案能兼顾有效性与多样性，从而使模型排名保持稳定。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces Khmer PFGen-Bench, the first judge-free benchmark for open-ended generation in the low-resource Khmer language, showing that mixing references from post-trained models across nine model families balances validity and variety, yielding stable model rankings.
